question.text: The maximum value of $z=6 x+8 y$ subject to constraints $2 x+y \leq 30, x+2 y \leq 24$ and $x \geq 0, y \geq 0$ is

solution.text: Here, $2 x+y \leq 30, x+2 y \leq 24, x, y \geq 0$ The shaded region represents the feasible region, hence $\mathrm{z}=6 \mathrm{x}+8 \mathrm{y}$. Obviously it is maximum at (12,6) Hence $z=12 \times 6+8 \times 6=120$
